statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. BOJ communication risk keeps Stress extreme, but current evidence does not establish persistent NQ mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; conditional risk is concentrated around BOJ communication and the U.S. data/open/expiration cluster.
headline: BOJ hike raises whipsaw risk without confirmed NQ tail path
body: The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.25% and the yen weakened while Asian equities rose. Oil and the U.S. 10-year yield are below recent peaks, while detailed live NQ retracement structure remains incomplete. Shared Finviz context is stale and excluded from current evidence.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours moved from low Tail into WATCH during Thursday's technology-led rally, briefly crossed the blocking threshold twice, then returned to low Tail after the cash close. The latest completed hour remained low Tail despite BOJ event risk.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low without persistent NQ extension or failed retracements. Conditional risk rises around the 06:30 UTC BOJ press conference and peaks around 13:00-14:30 UTC for U.S. data, the cash open, Bowman and expiration flows.

forecast.analysis: BOJ has raised its policy rate to 1.25%; the yen weakened and Asian equities rose. Oil and the U.S. 10-year yield are below recent peaks, while detailed live NQ retracement structure is incomplete, so Tail remains low and Stress stays event-heavy.
drivers: Observed BOJ hike with softer yen and stronger Asian equities
Detailed live NQ retracement structure remains incomplete
Oil and the U.S. 10-year yield are below recent peaks

forecast.analysis: If post-BOJ repricing continues without sustained NQ extension, Tail stays low. Ueda's 06:30 UTC press conference is a known checkpoint that can raise whipsaw risk before it proves a one-way price path.
drivers: BOJ Governor Ueda press conference at 06:30 UTC
Persistent NQ extension is still required for Tail escalation

news.title: BOJ raises interest rates to 31-year high in widely expected move

forecast.analysis: Ueda's press conference falls inside this hour. Stress rises around communication risk; Tail reaches WATCH only conditionally if NQ begins holding an extreme with shallow or failed retracements.
drivers: BOJ Governor Ueda press conference
Shallow or failed NQ retracements would be the escalation trigger

forecast.analysis: After BOJ communication, WATCH persists only if cross-asset repricing stays aligned and NQ fails to rotate. Two-way trade or meaningful pullbacks would push Tail back below WATCH.
drivers: Post-BOJ cross-asset alignment is a conditional checkpoint
Meaningful NQ pullbacks would reduce Tail

forecast.analysis: European cash participation should improve signal quality. Tail remains below WATCH if NQ shows normal retracements; repeated extensions after failed pullbacks would be the escalation trigger.
drivers: European participation improves cross-asset confirmation
Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: European flow and quarterly-expiration positioning can distort direction. WATCH reflects conditional flow risk, not an assumed trend; cross-asset conflict or deeper pullbacks would suppress Tail.
drivers: Quarterly-expiration positioning can distort European/U.S. handoff
Cross-asset conflict would limit directional conviction

forecast.analysis: U.S. catalysts move closer while European liquidity is active. Tail stays WATCH unless futures develop persistent directional efficiency with little mean reversion.
drivers: U.S. data/open cluster is approaching
Persistent directional efficiency remains the Tail condition

forecast.analysis: Pre-U.S. positioning can become more directional. Tail remains in WATCH because event proximity raises Stress before any release has printed.
drivers: Pre-U.S. positioning and expiration flows
Event proximity raises Stress before it raises Tail

forecast.analysis: The hour before Industrial Production carries high event and expiration uncertainty. Tail stays below the block threshold because neither the release result nor the post-release path is known.
drivers: Industrial Production is due at 13:15 UTC
Quarterly-expiration uncertainty is elevated

forecast.analysis: Industrial Production at 13:15 UTC and Bowman at 13:30 UTC coincide with the U.S. cash open. Tail reaches upper WATCH; escalation requires observed post-event extension with shallow or failed pullbacks.
drivers: Industrial Production at 13:15 UTC
Fed Vice Chair Bowman at 13:30 UTC
U.S. cash open and expiration flows

forecast.analysis: State Employment at 14:00 UTC lands during early cash trading and expiration flows. Upper WATCH persists conditionally if price discovery remains directional; meaningful retracements would lower Tail.
drivers: State Employment at 14:00 UTC
Early cash-session expiration flows
Meaningful retracements would lower Tail

forecast.analysis: After the data/open cluster, Tail begins to ease if NQ rotates and volatility decays. Continued extreme-holding with repeated failed retracements would instead keep risk elevated.
drivers: Post-event NQ rotation is the key invalidation
Repeated failed retracements would keep Tail elevated

forecast.analysis: Mid-session risk should normalize if the opening move is digested. Tail stays WATCH only while directional efficiency remains unresolved; two-way structure would favor lower risk.
drivers: Opening-move digestion should improve path clarity
Two-way structure would reduce Tail

forecast.analysis: With major scheduled U.S. releases behind the market, Tail should drift lower unless a delayed second leg appears across NQ and confirming cross-assets.
drivers: Delayed second-leg risk remains conditional
Cross-asset confirmation would be required for escalation

forecast.analysis: Late-session positioning can rebuild as expiration-related flows intensify. WATCH remains conditional on sustained directional pressure rather than generic volatility alone.
drivers: Late-session expiration positioning
Sustained NQ pressure, not volatility alone, governs Tail

forecast.analysis: Power hour and quarterly expiration create a narrow late-session risk window. Tail approaches upper WATCH if one-way extension persists into the close; reversal or rotation would invalidate it.
drivers: U.S. power hour
Quarterly-expiration close mechanics
One-way extension into the close would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: Into the cash close and futures handoff, Tail should ease if closing imbalances do not reinforce a one-way move. Persistent extreme-holding would keep WATCH active.
drivers: Cash-close imbalance behavior
Persistent extreme-holding would keep WATCH active

forecast.analysis: CME equity-index futures maintenance reduces observable price-path information. Tail is lower unless fresh evidence before the break shows a persistent unresolved directional path.
drivers: CME equity-index futures maintenance interval
Any unresolved pre-break one-way structure would remain relevant

forecast.analysis: After Globex reopens, Tail remains low if price discovery resumes with ordinary rotation. A discontinuous gap with failed retracements would be the main escalation condition.
drivers: Globex reopen restores price discovery
A discontinuous gap plus failed retracements would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: Late U.S. evening trade should carry lower event density. Tail stays low unless a fresh geopolitical or cross-asset shock creates persistent one-way NQ structure.
drivers: Lower scheduled event density
Fresh geopolitical discontinuity remains a conditional risk

forecast.analysis: Early Saturday UTC trade remains low Tail if futures continue to mean-revert. Thin liquidity can raise noise, but noise alone does not imply pathological direction.
drivers: Lower-liquidity trade can increase noise
Mean reversion would keep Tail low

forecast.analysis: Absent a new catalyst, lower-liquidity trade should keep Tail low. A credible geopolitical discontinuity or repeated extension would be required to re-escalate.
drivers: No scheduled high-impact U.S. catalyst in this hour
A fresh discontinuity would be required for re-escalation

forecast.analysis: With scheduled U.S. macro risk distant, Tail remains low under a two-way baseline. Cross-asset alignment against equities would matter only if NQ also shows persistent structure.
drivers: Scheduled U.S. macro risk is distant
Cross-asset alignment matters only with persistent NQ structure

forecast.analysis: Overnight risk stays low if no new catalyst produces a sustained NQ trend. Stress remains elevated by geopolitical uncertainty but is not sufficient to trigger a block.
drivers: No scheduled high-impact U.S. event in this hour
Geopolitical uncertainty raises Stress more than Tail without path confirmation
